mapper.select: select f.file_relation_id as fileRelationId, c1.C_Name as cName, c2.C_Name as asAuditUnitName, c1.C_Name_History as cNameHistory, c1.C_Abbreviation as cAbbName, pro.P_Name as pName, pro.P_Name_History as pNameHistory, pro.P_Code as pCode, proc.C_Name as pConstructionUnitName, proc.C_Abbreviation as pConsAbbName, prod.D_Name as pCompetentDepartmentName, sec.Sec_Name as secName, sec.Sec_Code as secCode, con.Con_Name as conName, con.Con_Code as conCode, con.Con_Money_Total as conMoneyTotal, mn.* from Audit_Settlement mn left join Sys_Company c1 on c1.C_Id=mn.As_Create_Cid left join Sys_Company c2 on c2.C_Id=mn.As_Audit_Unit left join Pre_Project pro on pro.P_Id=mn.P_Id left join SYS_Company proc on proc.C_Id=pro.P_Construction_Unit left join SYS_Department prod on prod.D_Id=pro.P_Competent_Department left join Sec_Info sec on sec.Sec_Id=mn.Sec_Id left join Con_Contract con on con.Con_Id=mn.Con_Id left join Sys_File f on f.FileID=mn.As_Id where mn.Con_Id=#{conId} and mn.as_state=7 order by mn.as_create_time desc limit 1

select f.file_relation_id as fileRelationId, c1.C_Name as cName, c2.C_Name as asAuditUnitName, c1.C_Name_History as cNameHistory, c1.C_Abbreviation as cAbbName, pro.P_Name as pName, pro.P_Name_History as pNameHistory, pro.P_Code as pCode, proc.C_Name as pConstructionUnitName, proc.C_Abbreviation as pConsAbbName, prod.D_Name as pCompetentDepartmentName, sec.Sec_Name as secName, sec.Sec_Code as secCode, con.Con_Name as conName, con.Con_Code as conCode, con.Con_Money_Total as conMoneyTotal, mn.* from Audit_Settlement mn left join Sys_Company c1 on c1.C_Id=mn.As_Create_Cid left join Sys_Company c2 on c2.C_Id=mn.As_Audit_Unit left join Pre_Project pro on pro.P_Id=mn.P_Id left join SYS_Company proc on proc.C_Id=pro.P_Construction_Unit left join SYS_Department prod on prod.D_Id=pro.P_Competent_Department left join Sec_Info sec on sec.Sec_Id=mn.Sec_Id left join Con_Contract con on con.Con_Id=mn.Con_Id left join Sys_File f on f.FileID=mn.As_Id where mn.As_Id=#{asId}
